## Purpose and Entry Points
Screenshot-to-Code is a local/self-hostable AI application that converts screenshots, mockups, Figma-like inputs, URLs, imported code, and recordings into editable web implementations across HTML, React, Vue, Bootstrap, and Ionic stacks. The React/Vite client starts at `frontend/src/main.tsx` and composes the application in `frontend/src/App.tsx`. The FastAPI service is exposed from `backend/main.py`; container deployment is coordinated by `docker-compose.yml`.

## Client Workspace and Interaction Model
The frontend is a browser-based generation workspace: users submit inputs, select output/model settings, observe generation activity, and inspect or edit generated code and preview output. The main input surface is `frontend/src/components/unified-input/UnifiedInputPane.tsx`; generation orchestration is initiated through `frontend/src/generateCode.ts`. Project state, generated variants, history, and UI persistence are centralized in `frontend/src/store/project-store.ts` and `frontend/src/store/app-store.ts`.

## API and Realtime Boundary
FastAPI route modules provide the backend’s HTTP/WebSocket-facing contract. Code generation is served by `backend/routes/generate_code.py`; browser capabilities and screenshot rendering are surfaced through `backend/routes/capabilities.py` and `backend/routes/screenshot.py`. The frontend connects using configured HTTP and WebSocket backend URLs. WebSocket status/event constants live in `backend/ws/constants.py`, supporting streamed progress for long-running model and agent operations rather than a request-only workflow.

## Generation Pipeline and Prompt Construction
Request parsing, stack-specific instructions, policies, planning, and multimodal prompt assembly are separated under `backend/prompts/`. `backend/prompts/pipeline.py` is the central prompt pipeline, with input normalization in `backend/prompts/request_parsing.py` and model message construction in `backend/prompts/message_builder.py`. Create and update flows have distinct prompts under `backend/prompts/create/` and `backend/prompts/update/`, allowing iterative revisions from prompt history or current file snapshots.

## Agentic Code Production
The agent subsystem executes iterative model/tool loops rather than only single-pass completion. `backend/agent/runner.py` drives runs, `backend/agent/engine.py` coordinates model decisions and state transitions, and `backend/agent/state.py` holds run state. Tools in `backend/agent/tools/` let the agent inspect assets, parse outputs, produce summaries, and invoke runtime functionality. This is the primary control boundary between untrusted/provider-generated instructions and controlled local capabilities.

## Model, Asset, and Media Integrations
A provider abstraction selects available OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini models: `backend/agent/providers/base.py`, `backend/agent/providers/factory.py`, and provider implementations such as `backend/agent/providers/openai.py`. Gemini-backed asset extraction is implemented through `backend/asset_extraction.py`; uploaded assets are stored and made available to prompts/tools via `backend/uploaded_assets/store.py`. Replicate-backed image generation/editing is isolated in `backend/image_generation/replicate.py`. Video support is represented by `backend/video/`.

## Visual Validation, Evaluation, and Operations
Generated pages can be rendered in headless Chromium for agent visual feedback through the preview abstraction in `backend/preview_screenshot/registry.py` and Playwright implementation `backend/preview_screenshot/playwright_backend.py`. Evaluation datasets, execution, and persisted sessions are organized in `backend/evals/runner.py`, `backend/evals/sets.py`, and `backend/evals/sessions.py`, with corresponding operator pages in `frontend/src/components/evals/`. Token usage and pricing are tracked separately under `backend/costs/`, while filesystem logging under `backend/fs_logging/` supports run inspection and prompt reporting.
